chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man whom death approached, so he freed his غلام and made a bequest, and it amounted to more than one-third.
He عليه السلام said: "The emancipation of the غلام is to be carried out, and the reduction is to be in what remains."

key_terms.الثُّلُثِ: one-third; the legal limit relevant to bequests
key_terms.النُّقْصَانُ: reduction; the decrease applied to the remaining bequests
key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death; the approach of death in the context of final bequests
key_terms.عِتْقُ: emancipation; the act of freeing the slave
key_terms.غُلَامَهُ: his غلام; the slave being manumitted
key_terms.فَأَعْتَقَ: he emancipated; he set a slave free
key_terms.وَأَوْصَى: he made a will; he issued a bequest

ai.seo_question: If a dying man frees a slave and also leaves bequests exceeding one-third, how is his estate carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a deathbed manumission together with a bequest that exceeds one-third of the estate. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the freeing of the slave is executed, while the reduction is applied to the remainder of the bequest.
